payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_revert.py::test_the_second_subset_is_each_old_test_a_changed_line_falls_inside stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/gates/core/revert.py. The claim was 'With `locations` reported at head, `revert` hands the `tests` gate a second subset in a second run, inside the same revert as the first. The subset is each name collected at base and at head whose head location names a file under `test_paths` and holds a line the diff changes. An added line is changed. A removed line marks the new-side line on each side of it. A context line marks nothing. The witness drives an added line inside a test and one at its first line. It also drives a removed last line and a line removed directly above a test. It leaves out a test only context lines reach, one in a file the diff left alone, one located outside `test_paths` and one with no location. It leaves out a test touched only by its base location, with a head location and without one, and one collected at base alone. It leaves out each name in the first subset, a `preserves` witness, an exempt name and a name reading as an option.', and the whole `tests` gate stayed green under the edit too.
